email.body1:
Lisa, saw Aware expanded the Awareness Platform with stronger liveness and matching, and landed its first mobile biometric deployment inside a US federal agency.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can work before the next launch, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Aware off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Lisa, quick follow-up for Aware.

As federal and commercial demand both climb, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Aware needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lisa, last bit of proof for Aware.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Aware's reply rate likely compares to other identity and security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
